declaredPurpose: Exercise W5 against twelve independently dumped, deliberately varied incidents spanning two structurally distinct application roots. This corpus selects a next prototype design problem; it is designed evidence, not an external observation or a field-readiness claim.

questions.userTask: Determine the request pipeline marker captured at the incident boundary.
questions.requiredContextKind: The unique rooted request pipeline and its captured Marker field.
manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Read the Marker field from its captured object bytes.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The exact marker distinguishes this incident from the alternate request branch and confirms direct-field evaluation is useful.

questions.userTask: Recover the combined request marker produced by the captured helper path.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted request pipeline plus its exact module, method, helper, and marker fields.
manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Resolve GetMarkerSummary and CombineMarkers.
Read both marker fields and reproduce the bounded addition.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The exact combined marker confirms that a bounded two-method computation answers a realistic request-pipeline question.

questions.userTask: Determine whether a degraded request still preserves useful evidence for its combined marker.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted request pipeline with only a captured prefix of Marker and exact remaining method context.

firstBoundary.explanation: The incident exposes only the first two of the four Marker bytes, so the combined value must remain unknown with lineage.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Retain the observed Marker prefix.
Avoid inventing the missing bytes while preserving the lineage-bearing answer.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The lineage-bearing partial result preserves enough evidence to continue triage instead of discarding the incident as wholly unreadable.

questions.userTask: Read the nested failure code associated with the failed request pipeline.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted request pipeline, its Failure reference, and the nested Code field.

firstBoundary.explanation: The admitted expression grammar cannot traverse the Failure reference to its Code field.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Follow Failure to the nested object.
Read Code from the failure object.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The prototype supplies no answer, so the operator must perform the complete nested walk manually.

questions.userTask: Read the nested status of the request active at the captured boundary.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted request pipeline, its CurrentRequest reference, and the nested Status field.

firstBoundary.explanation: The admitted expression grammar cannot traverse CurrentRequest to its Status field.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Follow CurrentRequest to its state record.
Read Status from the nested record.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The prototype cannot expose the requested nested state and therefore does not reduce the manual investigation.

questions.userTask: Determine what can still be concluded when the primary request marker bytes are unavailable.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted request pipeline with attributable but unavailable Marker bytes and exact remaining modeled context.

firstBoundary.explanation: No Marker bytes are present, so the model returns a lineage-bearing unknown rather than a fabricated value.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted request pipeline.
Attempt the Marker read and retain its unavailable state.
Use the unknown lineage to identify the missing prerequisite.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The typed unknown identifies a concrete missing field and prevents an incorrect exact conclusion while preserving the next acquisition action.

questions.userTask: Determine the batch marker captured for the active partition wave.
questions.requiredContextKind: The unique rooted batch pipeline and its captured Marker field.
manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted batch pipeline.
Read Marker from its captured object bytes.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The signed exact marker identifies the active partition wave and validates direct-field recovery on a second root shape.

questions.userTask: Recover the modeled combined marker for the batch pipeline.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted batch pipeline plus exact model identity and both marker fields.
manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted batch pipeline.
Resolve the exact GetMarkerSummary model.
Read both fields and apply its declared pure addition.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The exact modeled result confirms the same semantic answer on a structurally different application root.

questions.userTask: Determine whether the batch helper can run under a deliberately exhausted instruction budget.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted batch pipeline plus exact method and field evidence under a zero-instruction execution policy.

firstBoundary.explanation: The predeclared execution policy allows no instruction, so evaluation stops before consuming the method body.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Confirm exact root, method, helper, and field evidence.
Record that the explicit execution budget prevents evaluation.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The result faithfully explains the policy boundary but supplies no value for this incident.

questions.userTask: Read the nested failure code for the failed batch pipeline.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted batch pipeline, its LastFailure reference, and the nested Code field.

firstBoundary.explanation: The admitted expression grammar cannot traverse LastFailure to its Code field.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted batch pipeline.
Follow LastFailure to the nested object.
Read Code from that object.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The nested value remains inaccessible through the prototype and requires a complete manual walk.

questions.userTask: Read the nested progress state of the captured batch pipeline.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted batch pipeline, its Progress reference, and the nested State field.

firstBoundary.explanation: The admitted expression grammar cannot traverse Progress to its State field.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted batch pipeline.
Follow Progress to the nested record.
Read State from the progress record.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The requested operational state is outside the admitted member-navigation depth.

questions.userTask: Determine whether the batch summary can be recovered when its declaring module is unavailable.
questions.requiredContextKind: The rooted batch pipeline plus an attributable declaring module and method body.

firstBoundary.explanation: The incident evidence view exposes no declaring module from which the requested method body can be reacquired.

manualObjectWalkingOperations: Locate the rooted batch pipeline.
Attempt to identify the declaring module and stop when no candidate is available.
questions.decisionImpactExplanation: The typed acquisition failure prevents a false answer but cannot recover the requested summary.
